chunks: And We sent not before you [as messengers] except men whom We inspired from among the people of the towns. So have they not traveled through the earth and seen how was the end of those before them? And the home of the Hereafter is better for those who fear Allah; so will you not use reason?
ai.seo_question: Who were the prophets sent before Muhammad according to the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia exegesis to affirm the humanity and social rootedness of the Prophets, emphasizes that divine messengers were chosen from among the settled populations ('ahl al-qura') to serve as relatable models for their communities. It encourages believers to engage in historical reflection by traveling the earth to witness the consequences faced by earlier nations, thereby reinforcing the rational basis for faith. The conclusion underscores that the eternal abode of the Hereafter is superior for the God-conscious, inviting intellectual contemplation ('afala ta'qilun') on the transient nature of worldly power versus spiritual success.
